title: Pocket Mansion
description: Carry a private dimension in your inventory. Right-click the Pocket Dimension item to enter your own personal mansion world. Bring your favorite animals along with the Mob Capsule.
body:
# Pocket Mansion

**Your own private world — in your inventory.**

Pocket Mansion adds a personal dimension you can enter from anywhere with a single right-click. No portal frames to build. No coordinates to remember. Just craft the Pocket Dimension item, hold it, and step into a world that's yours alone.

Bring your favorite animals with you using the Mob Capsule. Build your dream mansion in peace. Return to the overworld whenever you want — the mod remembers exactly where you left.

---

## What's inside?

### 🏰 Pocket Dimension
A craftable item that takes you to your own private dimension. Right-click to enter. Right-click again from inside to return to exactly where you left the overworld. Each player gets their own private space — no other player can enter yours unless you bring them.

### 🐾 Mob Capsule
A reusable capture item for peaceful mobs. Right-click a cow, sheep, wolf, cat, parrot, or any non-hostile creature to store them inside. Carry them with you, walk into your Pocket Dimension, and release them there to build your personal sanctuary.

The Mob Capsule respects the world:
- ✅ Captures peaceful and tamed animals
- ❌ Cannot capture hostile mobs
- ❌ Cannot capture players
- 🏠 Mobs can only be released inside the Pocket Dimension — protecting other players' worlds from intrusions

---

## Recipes

### Pocket Dimension

O G O
G D G
O G O

**O** = Obsidian · **G** = Gold Ingot · **D** = Diamond

Yields: 1 Pocket Dimension

A mid-game crafting gate — you'll need to have ventured into the Nether for obsidian and found at least one diamond before you can craft your dimension. This keeps the item meaningful instead of trivial.

### Mob Capsule

. C .
C G C
. C .

**C** = Copper Ingot · **G** = Gold Ingot

Yields: 2 Mob Capsules

Affordable and craftable as soon as you have copper and gold — start collecting your menagerie early.

---

## How it works

1. **Craft a Pocket Dimension item.**
2. **Right-click it** in any world to step into your private dimension. The mod remembers exactly where you came from.
3. **Build.** It's your world — there are no hostile mobs, no time pressure, no other players. Build a mansion, a farm, a museum, whatever you want.
4. **Bring company.** Craft Mob Capsules, capture your favorite animals, and release them in your Pocket Dimension to keep you company.
5. **Right-click the item again** from inside to return to your exact starting point. Step in and out as often as you want.

---

## Why use it?

- **Privacy on multiplayer servers** — no one can grief your build because no one can find it.
- **A safe creative space** without changing the rules of your main world.
- **An animal sanctuary** for your tamed pets and farm animals.
- **A separate project space** — start a build without committing to a location in your main world.
- **No portal hassle** — no obsidian frames, no flint and steel, no coordinates. Just one item.

---

## Languages

- English

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.10 (26.1.2)
- NeoForge 26.1.2.26-beta or newer

---

## Status

This is an early release (v0.1.0). The core mechanics are stable and tested:
- ✅ Pocket Dimension item and dimension travel
- ✅ Return-point persistence across sessions
- ✅ Mob Capsule capture and release logic
- ✅ Hostile/player capture protection

Planned for future versions:
- Decorative mansion-building blocks themed for the dimension
- Multiple dimension layouts to choose from
- Shared dimensions (invite friends)

Feedback and feature requests are welcome.
